caption: The video captures three pigeons on a grassy backyard lawn bordered by a weathered wooden fence on the left and a brown shed with dark wire mesh on the right. A large foreground pigeon with a light grey body, black wing bars and an iridescent neck holds its position right of center. It faces right, making only small head turns and posture adjustments. Behind it, two smaller pigeons shift about in the mid-ground. The left pigeon gradually changes stance, cocking its tail and turning its body toward the camera while staying in roughly the same spot. The reddish-breasted pigeon on the right alternates between dipping its head toward the grass and raising it, closing the gap until it stands beside its companion. The background house, green bucket and potted plants stay fixed, indicating a static camera as the birds continue their slow, unsettled movements.
